name: Moere
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Only Z'graggen 1975/1980 wordlists and Pick 2020/2022 comparative reconstruction (doctype minimal); no description of Moere prosody exists.

sources.citation: Berghäll, Liisa. 2015. A grammar of Mauwake. Studies in Diversity Linguistics 4. Berlin: Language Science Press.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Closest documented relative (Kumil subgroup); p. 42 gives Mauwake second-syllable stress. Useful only as a family-level comparator, not as a Moere source.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, J.A. 1971. Classificatory and typological studies in languages of the Madang District. Pacific Linguistics C-19. Canberra: ANU.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Moere not yet recorded ('Moie: unrecorded; south of Bepour'). General remark p. 6: 'The marking of stress has been omitted, since the stress patterning has not been well established yet.' Not about Moere.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.1 languoid page moer1240; local hh.bib
sources.note: Only Z'graggen 1971/1975/1980 and Pick 2020/2022 listed; Glottolog lists no grammar, sketch or phonology. No grammar, sketch or phonology exists for Moere.

sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2020. A Reconstruction of Proto-Northern Adelbert Phonology and Lexicon. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Mānoa. 485 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: pp. 31-32 'Stress': stress described only for Mauwake (2nd syllable, Berghäll 2015), Pamosu (Tupper 2012) and Usan (phonemic, Reesink 1987); 'the available data on stress in most languages are minimal or nonexistent'. Section 3.10 Moere (pp. 138-139) gives only a phoneme inventory from Z'graggen's wordlist and recordings; nothing on stress. 9.3.4 'Sound changes in Moere' (p. 393): nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, J.A. 1980. A comparative word list of the Northern Adelbert Range languages, Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. Pacific Linguistics D-31. Canberra: ANU. xvi+194 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Moere is list F7. Introduction p. viii: transcription is 'semi-phonemic'; no stress marks in the transcriptions (checked p. 12 image) and no mention of stress anywhere in the volume.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, J.A. 1975. The languages of the Madang District, Papua New Guinea. Pacific Linguistics B-41. Canberra: ANU.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Classification and village census only (Moere F7, 56 speakers, alt. name Moira); no phonology, no stress.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, J.A. 1975. The Madang-Adelbert Range Sub-Phylum. In S.A. Wurm (ed.), New Guinea Area Languages and Language Study Vol 1, 569-612. Pacific Linguistics C-38.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Subgrouping and pronoun tables; Moere appears only in tables; nothing on stress (a full-text search for stress/accent PDF pp. 560-640, saved).

sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2022. A Reconstruction of Proto-Northern Adelbert Phonology and Lexicon. In Epps, Law & Pat-El (eds.), Historical Linguistics and Endangered Languages: Exploring Diversity in Language Change, 215-262. New York: Routledge.

sources.note: Published abridgement of the dissertation; would only matter if it added prosodic notes on Moere, which is unlikely.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, J.A. (collector). 1971b. John Z'graggen's recordings. Collection JZ2, PARADISEC (Moere elicitation sessions).
